answer: Farming becomes a nectar bet on surviving 120 epochs of grading, and every echo settlement recomputes the juniper schedule, so someone who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 120 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
